qt: to the Commission Giuseppe Antoci (The Left) Subject:

In its reply to question E-002008/20241 on the water crisis in the province of Enna, the Commission referred to around EUR 460 million allocated through several ERDF programmes for sustainable water management in Sicily, with priority given to reducing losses. The Commission clarified that the selection of operations is the responsibility of the national and regional authorities and that it monitors the implementation of the programmes. The subsequent answer to question E-003807/20252 provided aggregated regional data, without identifying the interventions that are helping the province of Enna or their results. In light of the above and on the basis of the information provided by the managing authorities, can the Commission answer the following questions: 1.

What interventions financed by the ERDF programmes referred to in the answer to E002008/2024 are addressing the water supply in Enna, including through supramunicipal infrastructure? Please indicate the name, the municipalities served, the resources allocated and the deadlines for completion.

What is the up-to-date physical and financial progress of each intervention? Please state the expenditure incurred by beneficiaries separately from the reimbursements received from the EU and indicate any delays regarding the deadlines.
What measurable objectives and documented results are available for these interventions in terms of reducing losses and improving continuity of water supply in Enna’s municipalities?
at: EN on behalf of the European Commission (25.11.2026) According to the Common Provisions Regulation1, the Member States and the Commission shall implement the budget of the EU allocated to the European Regional Development Fund2 under shared management. As the Commission explained in its reply to Parliamentary Question E-002008/20243 the selection and funding of operations are the responsibility of the regional or national authorities managing the programmes. Therefore, the detailed information requested by the Honourable Member on the state of implementation of specific interventions addressing water supply in the province of Enna should be sought from the relevant Member State authorities and the managing authorities responsible for the programmes concerned.
1 Regulation (EU) 2021/1060 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 24 June 2021 laying down

common provisions on the European Regional Development Fund, the European Social Fund Plus, the Cohesion Fund, the Just Transition Fund and the European Maritime, Fisheries and Aquaculture Fund and financial rules for those and for the Asylum, Migration and Integration Fund, the Internal Security Fund and the Instrument for Financial Support for Border Management and Visa Policy. 2 https://ec.europa.eu/regional_policy/funding/erdf_en. 3 Parliamentary Question E-002008/2024 - https://www.europarl.europa.eu/doceo/document/E-10-2024-002008ASW_EN.html.
